displayAddress: Mont Le Grand, Exeter, Devon, EX1
description:
Property Description

Mont Le Grand is a spacious one bedroom lower ground floor apartment, forming part of an attractive grade II listed period building and enjoying a particularly convenient position close to the heart of Exeter.

The property offers unusually generous accommodation for a one bedroom apartment and, while it would now benefit from some updating, provides an excellent opportunity for a purchaser to improve and personalise the property to their own taste.

Sitting Room

The generous sitting room measures approximately 14'10" x 11'2" and provides plenty of space for both seating and additional furniture. A large sash style window brings natural light into the room and enjoys a pleasant outlook towards the surrounding greenery, while a fireplace provides a focal point.

Kitchen

The separate kitchen is another particularly good sized room, measuring about 15'9" x 9'2". The existing kitchen provides storage and worktop space together with room for appliances and informal dining.

The room offers excellent potential for a purchaser wishing to update the kitchen and create a more contemporary space.

Bedroom

The bedroom measures approximately 14'9" x 8'11" and provides a comfortable double room with space for additional bedroom furniture. A large sash style window provides natural light and an outlook towards the gardens.

Bathroom

The bathroom is unusually generous for a one bedroom apartment, measuring approximately 11'6" x 6'8", and is fitted with a bath, WC and wash basin.

Outside

A particular feature of Mont Le Grand is the established communal garden, providing residents with an attractive and surprisingly generous area of green space.

Predominantly laid to lawn and surrounded by mature trees, shrubs and planting, the gardens provide a pleasant place to sit outside and enjoy the surroundings, adding considerably to the appeal of the property.

A garage is also available by separate negotiation.

Location

Mont Le Grand occupies a sought after and established position close to the heart of Exeter, combining a surprisingly green setting with excellent access to the city centre.

The property is particularly well placed for everyday amenities, with Waitrose just a short distance away, together with the shops and facilities along Heavitree Road. The Royal Devon and Exeter Hospital, Magdalen Road and Exeter city centre are also within easy reach.

Despite its convenient position, Mont Le Grand has a pleasantly leafy and established feel, with mature surroundings and communal gardens providing welcome green space.

With its generous proportions, communal gardens, convenient location and considerable scope for improvement, Mont Le Grand represents an excellent opportunity for first time buyers, owner occupiers, investors or those seeking a well located Exeter base.

Property Information

LEASE LENGTH: 184 years from and including 25th March 1988

Each flat contributes 25% of cost when work is needed

GARAGE: Available by separate negotiation
